correctness.rationale: The integral certificate verifies uv=0 in the toric base. MU*(B) is torsion-free by the even-cell Atiyah--Hirzebruch spectral sequence, and its rational Chern--Dold image makes c1MU(Lu)c1MU(Lv) divisible by uv, so it vanishes integrally. MU orientation maps transfer the vanishing to every complex-oriented theory. For any one-dimensional formal group law F, F(x,U)F(x,V)-xF(x,F(U,V)) is divisible by UV; the rank-two projective-bundle relations coincide and determine the rings. Tangent determinant and K0 lambda calculations are explicit. Nonhomotopy is Theorem 4.1 of Gong--Li.

value.rationale: The newly published counterexample leaves open whether universal complex cobordism, arbitrary complex-oriented generalized cohomology, or enriched K0 lambda operations restore homotopy rigidity. The theorem proves a uniform structural failure for all these stronger invariants, with a universal vanishing-product mechanism and compatible generalized tangent Chern data. It therefore sets a natural boundary for refinements of toric cohomological rigidity rather than merely recomputing ordinary cohomology.
